sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain from NPR.
In May 2007, an artist living in Chicago moved into a new place.
sentences.zh: 2007年5月，一位住在芝加哥的艺术家搬进了一个新地方。

sentences.en: It was a small room with white walls.
sentences.zh: 那是一个四周白墙的小房间。

sentences.en: There was a bed, a desk, a computer, a lamp, and a paintball gun.
sentences.zh: 里面有一张床、一张桌子、一台电脑、一盏台灯和一把漆弹枪。

sentences.en: Affixed to the gun was a webcam.
sentences.zh: 枪上绑着一个网络摄像头。

sentences.en: It live-streamed the room to the internet.
sentences.zh: 它向互联网直播这个房间。

sentences.en: Anyone could look in, and anyone could take control of the gun, aim, and fire.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以窥视，任何人都可以控制这把枪、瞄准并开火。

sentences.en: At all hours of the day and night, the paintball gun would spring to life
sentences.zh: 无论白天黑夜的任何时刻，这把漆弹枪都会活跃起来

sentences.en: and begin shooting yellow pellets into the room.
sentences.zh: 并开始向房间里发射黄色漆弹。

sentences.en: Some hit the walls or the furniture.
sentences.zh: 有些击中了墙壁或家具。

sentences.en: I was shot at 70,000 times, and I received 80 million hits on the internet from 128 countries.
sentences.zh: 我被射击了7万次，在互联网上收到了来自128个国家的8000万次点击量。

sentences.en: Wafa Bilal spent one whole month in the room, targeted tens of thousands of times by random strangers around the world.
sentences.zh: 瓦法·比拉尔在房间里度过了整整一个月，成为全世界无数陌生人成千上万次瞄准的目标。

sentences.en: Why would he choose to do this?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要选择这样做？

sentences.en: Wafa was born and raised in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 瓦法出生并在伊拉克长大。

sentences.en: I live this duality of living in two places.
sentences.zh: 我体验着生活在两个地方的双重性。

sentences.en: One is a comfort zone of the United States, and the other one is the conflict zone in Iraq, where my family, friends, live.
sentences.zh: 一个是作为舒适区的美国，另一个是我家人和朋友生活的伊拉克冲突区。

sentences.en: In 2004, Wafa says one of his brothers was killed in an airstrike.
sentences.zh: 瓦法说，2004年，他的一个兄弟在空袭中丧生。

sentences.en: One of my brothers, Haji, was killed in an air-to-ground missile, and I didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我的一个兄弟哈吉死于地对空导弹，我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Wafa is a performance artist, and he wanted to engage others in the conversation that was running through his mind.
sentences.zh: 瓦法是一位行为艺术家，他想让其他人参与到他脑海中盘旋的对话中。

sentences.en: Three years after his brother's death, he got an idea.
sentences.zh: 在他兄弟去世三年后，他有了一个想法。

sentences.en: In January of 2007, I was watching TV, and I was watching an interview with an American soldier.
sentences.zh: 2007年1月，我在看电视，看的是对一名美国士兵的采访。

sentences.en: Sitting in the United States, the soldier directed drones to fire missiles thousands of miles away in the Iraqi desert.
sentences.zh: 这名士兵身在美国，却指挥着数千英里外伊拉克沙漠中的无人机发射导弹。

sentences.en: I was shocked how the soldier completely disconnected physically and emotionally from what happened on the ground in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 我感到震惊的是，这名士兵竟然与伊拉克地面上发生的事情在身体和情感上完全脱节。

sentences.en: At the time, Wafa was living in Chicago.
He came up with a proposal and presented it to a gallery.
sentences.zh: 他想出一个方案并呈交给一个画廊。

sentences.en: I said, I want to lock myself in the gallery space for 30 days, and I'm going to build a robot connected to the Internet.
sentences.zh: 我说，我想把自己锁在画廊空间30天，我要造一个连接互联网的机器人。

sentences.en: And the robot shoots a paintball, and viewers online could direct that gun and shoot at me.
sentences.zh: 机器人会发射漆弹，网上的观众可以指挥那把枪向我射击。

sentences.en: This one from, it says from Milwaukee.
sentences.zh: 这一枪来自，上面说是来自密尔沃基。

sentences.en: The idea was to turn ordinary people into drone operators who could target someone far away.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是将普通人变成可以瞄准远处某人的无人机操作员。

sentences.en: Except, in this case, people would not be following orders.
sentences.zh: 只不过，在这种情况下，人们不会是在服从命令。

sentences.en: They would have a choice about whether to shoot.
sentences.zh: 他们可以自由选择是否开枪。

sentences.en: And you could see the human being on the other end.
sentences.zh: 而你可以看到另一端的人类。
瓦法的痛苦将是显而易见的。

sentences.en: When you are in this little room, you see the sheer destruction.
sentences.zh: 当你身处这个小房间时，你会看到彻彻底底的破坏。

sentences.en: But if you are online, it becomes like a video game.
sentences.zh: 但如果你在网上，它就变成了一个电子游戏。

sentences.en: And that's another thing that I wanted to connect with people.
sentences.zh: 这也是我想与人们产生连接的另一件事。

sentences.en: That there is real consequences to these actions.
sentences.zh: 这些行为会产生真实的后果。

sentences.en: As the days went by, Wafa started to feel crushed by the experience.
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，瓦法开始感到被这段经历压垮。

sentences.en: In some ways, Wafa was attempting to do what civil disobedience movements around the world have done.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，瓦法正试图做世界各地民权运动所做的事情。

sentences.en: He was deliberately putting himself in harm's way in order to draw attention to a problem and affect change.
sentences.zh: 他故意让自己身处险境，以引起人们对一个问题的关注并推动变革。

sentences.en: Why did strangers who knew nothing about Wafa take it upon themselves to hurt him?
sentences.zh: 为什么那些对瓦法一无所知的陌生人会自发地去伤害他？

sentences.en: Do technology and modern life and the anonymity they offer make us less caring as human beings?
sentences.zh: 科技、现代生活以及它们提供的匿名性，是否让我们作为人类变得更加冷漠？

sentences.en: On today's show, building empathy in a connected and confrontational world.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将在一个互联且对抗的世界中建立同理心。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, think deeply.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》，深度思考。

sentences.en: We kick off our annual summer series, U2.0.
sentences.zh: 我们开启年度夏季系列节目“U2.0”。

sentences.en: I have been dragged into this all the way, kicking and screaming.
sentences.zh: 我一路被连拖带拽地卷入其中，又踢又叫。

sentences.en: Ideas and advice about how you can respond to life's chaos.
sentences.zh: 关于如何应对生活混乱的理念和建议。

sentences.en: Just do a just check to my inbox.
sentences.zh: 只是查一下我的收件箱。

sentences.en: Just check to my phone real quick.
We begin the series with an exploration of the power and the costs of empathy.
sentences.zh: 我们以对同理心的力量和代价的探讨来开启这个系列。

sentences.en: By putting ourselves into the story of people who, on the surface, appear different from us,
sentences.zh: 通过把自己代入那些表面上看起来与我们不同的人的故事中，

sentences.en: we can recognize our common humanity with them, and that can trigger empathy in a really natural way.
sentences.zh: 我们能够认识到我们与他们共同的人性，这可以以一种非常自然的方式激发同理心。

sentences.en: Jamil Zaki is a psychologist at Stanford University.
sentences.zh: 贾米尔·扎基是斯坦福大学的心理学家。

sentences.en: He's the author of the book, The War for Kindness, Building Empathy in a Fractured World.
sentences.zh: 他是《善良之战：在破碎的世界中建立同理心》一书的作者。
贾米尔，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: You have a very powerful story about how you came to be interested in the subject of empathy.
sentences.zh: 你有一个非常震撼的故事，关于你是如何对同理心这个主题产生兴趣的。

sentences.en: Tell me about your parents, where they are from, how they met, what they went through, and what you learned from the experience.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲你的父母，他们来自哪里，他们是如何相遇的，他们经历了什么，以及你从这段经历中学到了什么。

sentences.en: So it turns out that in the early 1970s,
Washington State University in Pullman had a program where they granted full scholarships for graduate studies to students from the world's poorest nations.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州立大学普尔曼分校有一个项目，向来自世界上最贫穷国家的学生提供研究生全额奖学金。

sentences.en: My mother received the scholarship from Peru, and my father did not receive a scholarship, but nonetheless came to Washington State from Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 我母亲获得了来自秘鲁的奖学金，我父亲没有获得奖学金，但依然从巴基斯坦来到了华盛顿州立大学。

sentences.en: So they traveled from Lima and Lahore, these two massive cities, to the sleepy town of Pullman, where they fell in love.
sentences.zh: 于是他们从利马和拉合尔这两个巨大的城市，来到了普尔曼这个安静的小镇，并在那里坠入爱河。

sentences.en: When I think about my parents, I think the biggest thing that they had in common was their sense of foreignness in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当我想到我的父母时，我认为他们最大的共同点就是在美国的异乡感。

sentences.en: They sort of took comfort in each other in a place that neither of them understood.
sentences.zh: 在一个彼此都不了解的地方，他们从对方身上寻求慰藉。

sentences.en: But as they grew more comfortable with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但随着他们对美国越来越习惯

sentences.en: and were acclimated to it, they grew less comfortable with each other.
sentences.zh: 并适应了这里，他们对彼此却越来越不适应。

sentences.en: And they divorced, they started splitting up when I was eight, but didn't finish until I was 12, and theirs was a long and acrimonious split, and I am their only child.
sentences.zh: 于是他们离婚了，在我8岁时开始分居，直到我12岁才彻底结束，他们的分居漫长而充满敌意，而我是他们的独生子。

sentences.en: And so a lot of my childhood was spent kind of bouncing around between their houses, and it really felt like I was bouncing between parallel universes,
sentences.zh: 所以我的童年很大一部分时间都在他们的房子之间来回奔波，感觉就像是在平行宇宙之间穿梭，

sentences.en: because their priorities and values and fears are really as far apart as their hometowns.
sentences.zh: 因为他们的优先事项、价值观和恐惧确实和他们的家乡一样天差地别。

sentences.en: So I would often feel confused, you know, as a small child.
sentences.zh: 所以作为一个小孩，我经常感到困惑，你知道的。

sentences.en: I would try to, when I was with my mom, figure out the rules that governed her heart and mind and make them true for myself.
sentences.zh: 我和妈妈在一起时，会试图弄清楚支配她内心和思想的规则，并让这些规则对我也成立。

sentences.en: But then when I would go to my dad's house, those same rules would stop working.
sentences.zh: 但当我去了爸爸家，同样的规则就不起作用了。

sentences.en: And it was just very confusing, and it felt, I think, to all three of us, like I would really have to choose one of my parents and give up on really knowing the other.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人困惑，而且对于我们三个人来说，我觉得我不得不选择其中一位父母，并放弃真正去了解另一位。

sentences.en: But I knew that I had to try for all of our sake.
sentences.zh: 但我知道为了我们所有人的利益，我必须尝试。

sentences.en: So I did, and I kind of kept working at it, and eventually got better and learned to tune myself to my parents' different frequencies.
sentences.zh: 所以我照做了，我一直为此努力，最终有所进步，学会了让自己去适应父母不同的频率。

sentences.en: And that kind of saved me as a kid.
sentences.zh: 作为孩子，那种经历在某种程度上拯救了我。
我认为是同理心拯救了我。

sentences.en: Not because it was easy, it was work.
sentences.zh: 不是因为它很简单，这需要努力。

sentences.en: I always think of my parents' divorce as an empathy gym for me that forced me to work out my ability to care about and understand other people.
sentences.zh: 我总是把父母的离婚看作是我的“同理心健身房”，它迫使我锻炼去关心和理解其他人的能力。

sentences.en: And you, as you said, described this as an empathy gym.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，你将这描述为同理心健身房。

sentences.en: Were there times when you failed to show them empathy?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么时候你未能对他们表现出同理心？

sentences.en: I mean, I must imagine that as a small child, it must have been very difficult in many ways to comprehend what was happening
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，可以想象，作为一个小孩子，在很多方面要理解正在发生的事情一定非常困难，

sentences.en: and why these two adults were fighting over you, and each was demanding that you see things from their point of view.
sentences.zh: 为什么这两个成年人会为了你而争吵，并且每个人都要求你从他们的角度来看待问题。

sentences.en: I mean, one of the big realizations for me as a kid was realizing that both of them were in pain.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，作为一个孩子，我最大的领悟之一就是意识到他们俩都在痛苦中。

sentences.en: I think as a child, it's very easy to focus on your own perspective and what you're going through and to blame others, especially adults.
sentences.zh: 我认为作为孩子，很容易专注于你自己的视角以及你正在经历的事情，并责备他人，尤其是成年人。

sentences.en: I think when I realized that my parents were both struggling, just like I was, it actually made me feel kinship towards them
sentences.zh: 我想当我意识到我的父母和我一样都在苦苦挣扎时，这实际上让我对他们产生了亲近感，

sentences.en: and made it easier to understand that I could connect with both of them.
sentences.zh: 并且更容易让我明白我可以与他们两人都建立连接。

sentences.en: In fact, because what we were going through wasn't that different.
sentences.zh: 事实上，因为我们经历的事情并没有那么不同。

sentences.en: Talk a little bit about the benefits of empathy.
There's been a lot of work that looks at what happens when people receive empathy from their partners, for example, or from their doctors.
sentences.zh: 有很多研究探讨了当人们从伴侣或医生那里获得同理心时会发生什么。

sentences.en: I mean, in many cases, empathy benefits all parties involved.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在许多情况下，同理心对所有相关方都有益。

sentences.en: So, for instance, patients of empathic doctors are more satisfied with their care, but are also more likely to follow doctors' recommendations,
sentences.zh: 例如，拥有富有同理心的医生的患者对他们的护理更加满意，同时也更有可能遵循医生的建议，

sentences.en: which is important for things like preventative care.
sentences.zh: 这对于诸如预防性护理之类的事情很重要。

sentences.en: And spouses of empathic partners are happier in their marriages.
sentences.zh: 拥有富有同理心的伴侣的夫妻在婚姻中更幸福。

sentences.en: But one thing that I think people don't realize as much is that people who experience empathy for others also benefit.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得人们没有意识到的一点是，对他人体验到同理心的人也会受益。

sentences.en: It's not just receiving it, but giving it helps us, too.
sentences.zh: 不仅是接受它，给予它对我们也有帮助。

sentences.en: So people who are relatively high in empathy, for instance, are less likely to become depressed.
sentences.zh: 例如，同理心水平相对较高的人不太可能患上抑郁症。

sentences.en: Feeling empathy for others reduces our stress.
sentences.zh: 对他人感同身受可以减轻我们的压力。

sentences.en: And adolescents who are able to pick out other people's emotions accurately are better adjusted during middle school.
sentences.zh: 能够在初中阶段准确辨别他人情绪的青少年适应得更好。

sentences.en: Now, parents everywhere recognize the value of empathy.
sentences.zh: 现在，各地的父母都认识到了同理心的价值。

sentences.en: We have courses and classes that try and teach children empathy.
sentences.zh: 我们有各种课程和班级试图教导儿童同理心。

sentences.en: I came by this clip on Sesame Street featuring the actor Mark Ruffalo and the character Murray.
sentences.zh: 我偶然看到了《芝麻街》里的这个片段，由演员马克·鲁法洛和角色默里出演。

sentences.en: Take a listen to the clip.
Did I tell you about that time when I lost my favorite teddy bear?
sentences.zh: 我跟你说过我弄丢最喜欢的泰迪熊的那次经历吗？

sentences.en: Did you love that teddy bear?
Oh, I can imagine exactly how you feel.
sentences.zh: 哦，我完全能想象你现在的感受。
你知道什么是同理心吗？

sentences.en: You could understand how I was feeling, exactly how I was feeling, and understood it.
sentences.zh: 你能理解我的感受，确切地理解我的感受，并且理解了它。

sentences.en: Jamil, you've used a similar kind of scenario to explain empathy.
sentences.zh: 贾米尔，你曾用过类似的情景来解释同理心。

sentences.en: The friend gets a phone call.
Walk me through the rest of that scenario and the three components that you've identified
sentences.zh: 请带我了解该情景的其余部分以及你所识别出的构成同理心的三个要素。

sentences.en: So, again, imagine that you're sitting with the friend having lunch, and they receive a
sentences.zh: 那么，再次想象一下，你正和朋友坐在一起吃午饭，他们接到一个

sentences.en: And whatever the person on the other side of the line says makes them visibly upset.
sentences.zh: 无论电话那头的人说了什么，都让他们显得心烦意乱。

sentences.en: You don't know what's wrong, but your friend starts to cry, and it's obvious that something
sentences.zh: 你不知道出了什么事，但你的朋友开始哭泣，很明显

sentences.en: Well, as you see this, a bunch of things might happen inside you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，当你看到这一幕时，你的内心可能会发生一系列变化。

sentences.en: First, you might become upset yourself, sort of vicariously catching their feeling.
sentences.zh: 首先，你自己可能会感到心烦意乱，有点像是间接地感受到了他们的情绪。

sentences.en: That's what psychologists often call emotional empathy.
sentences.zh: 心理学家通常称之为情绪共情。

sentences.en: You might also try to figure out what's wrong, what they're feeling, and why.
sentences.zh: 你可能还会试图弄清楚出了什么问题、他们的感受是什么以及原因何在。

sentences.en: That's what we call cognitive empathy.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所说的认知共情。

sentences.en: And if you're a good friend, at least, you probably will feel concern for what they're
sentences.zh: 而且如果你至少是个好朋友，你大概会为他们所经历的

sentences.en: going through and a desire for their well-being to improve.
sentences.zh: 事情感到担忧，并希望他们的处境能够变好。

sentences.en: That's what psychologists call empathic concern or compassion.
sentences.zh: 心理学家称之为同理关怀或同情。

sentences.en: And even though these pieces of empathy sometimes go together, they also split apart in interesting
sentences.zh: 尽管共情的这些不同方面有时会结合在一起，但它们也会以有趣的方式

sentences.en: So, for instance, different brain systems support emotional and cognitive empathy and empathic
sentences.zh: 比方说，不同的脑区系统支持着情绪共情、认知共情和同理关怀。
而且不同的人群在不同类型的共情上也会面临困难。

sentences.en: And different groups of people struggle with different flavors of empathy.
sentences.zh: 例如，患有自闭症谱系障碍的人有时在理解他人方面会遇到困难，

sentences.en: People with autism spectrum disorders, for instance, struggle sometimes to understand others,
sentences.zh: 也就是他们的认知共情，但在分享别人的情绪或关心

sentences.en: their cognitive empathy, but don't struggle as much to share other people's emotions or care
sentences.zh: 别人感受这方面并没有那么大的困难。
患有精神病态的人则有着完全相反的特点。

sentences.en: Individuals with psychopathy have the opposite profile.
sentences.zh: 他们通常完全能够理解别人的感受，但他们并不

sentences.en: They're often perfectly able to understand what other people feel, but they don't share

sentences.zh: 这简直就像是不同的肌肉群，你必须让所有的肌肉群都发挥作用，

sentences.en: It's almost like these are different muscle groups and you need all the muscle groups to
sentences.zh: 才能在某种程度上实现你共情能力的全部潜力。

sentences.en: be functioning to, in some ways, actualize your full capacity for empathy.

sentences.zh: 是的，这个说法太贴切了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a perfect way of putting it.
sentences.zh: 因此，正当父母、书籍、励志演讲者和传统信仰

sentences.en: So, at the same time that parents and books and motivational speakers and faith traditions
sentences.zh: 都在称赞共情的价值时，也有一些证据表明共情可能正在随时间发生变化，

sentences.en: cite the value of empathy, there is also some evidence that empathy might be changing over
sentences.zh: 而且不一定朝着好的方向发展。

sentences.en: time and not necessarily in a good way.
sentences.zh: 你引用了一项将2009年的平均共情水平与1979年的平均水平进行对比的研究。

sentences.en: You cite research that compares the average level of empathy in 2009 to the average in 1979.

我们发现这个短暂的模拟能够强有力地影响人们对无家可归者的同理心，甚至在一个月后经历过该模拟的人与对照组相比，更不容易将无家可归者非人化，并且他们更支持能够为湾区人民提供可负担住房的政策，而在这里这是一个非常敏感的话题。
所以再次表明，通过把自己代入那些表面上看起来与我们不同的人的故事中，正如你精彩地指出的那样，我们能够认识到我们与他们共同的人性，并且这可以以一种真正自然的方式激发同理心。
还有一些不太高科技的方法能让人设身处地去理解其他人，你在书中提到的方法之一就是戏剧的概念。
演员的身份在某些方面如何促使你锻炼同理心这块肌肉呢？

是的，我的意思是如果你想想表演是什么，那就是你真正极其深刻地把自己沉浸在角色中，以至于你不再是你自己，而开始在一段时间内成为他们，我的意思是，我想说这不仅仅是设身处地为他们着想，你几乎是走进了他们的皮肤，因此至少有一些证据表明表演实际上增强了人们的同理心，所以在一组很棒的研究中，Talia Goldstein 研究了就读于表演艺术高中的青少年，并将他们在学年初和年末的表现与接受视觉艺术培训的学生进行了比较，她发现那种表演训练比接受其他类型艺术培训的孩子更能提高同理心，这并不是说视觉艺术培训没有优势，我确信它是有的，但是通过以这种方式体验另一个人
